_movie: contents.dxr: the St. Hermelin Festival hub (welcome, enter the school, attraction menu)

281.en: Chisato: "Welcome to St. Hermelin High! Our school festival is in full swing! We've got all kinds of exhibits and fun games waiting just for you!"

285.en: Yosuke: "There are 5 tickets in all to win at the attractions. Collect as many as you can, and enjoy the hidden attractions too!"

ops.text: Do you want to go inside the school?

292.en: Himeno: "Nanjo and Elly will read your fortune with tarot cards."

293.en: Himeno: "Mark is showing off his wall paintings... You can even put the ones you like on your desktop, apparently!"

294.en: Himeno: "This is Tadashi and Tamaki's karaoke room... I hope they don't end up fighting..."

295.en: Himeno: "Th-this is the principal's office... Do you want to go in?"

296.en: Himeno: "In the nurse's office, Ms. Natsumi will give you a free checkup."

297.en: Himeno: "At the traveling Velvet Room, Igor will find the Persona that suits you best."

298.en: Himeno: "Philemon will assess how well suited you are to be a leader."

299.en: Himeno: "Maki should be showing her paintings in the art room... but she seemed flustered. Could you check on her? You can have the ticket I left with her."

300.en: Himeno: "Reiji is doing his famous magic tricks. Answer his and Brown's quiz correctly and you'll get a ticket!"

301.en: Himeno: "Yokouchi just ran into the cafeteria all fired up about a game with his pet turtle. Beat him and you'll get a ticket!"

302.en: Himeno: "Oh, Ms. Saeko asked me to send everyone to the gym. Something about handing out tickets... I think that's what she said."

303.en: Himeno: "Th-the vice principal has a booth too... Looks like a shooting gallery. Clear the game and you'll get a ticket!"

307.en: Himeno: "Wh-which attraction would you like to visit?"
